note: Model-proposed tool dependency edges, merged by scripts/dev/build-tool-graph.mjs. The build never calls a model — a build that reached one would produce a different corpus on every run — so a model reads two tool declarations offline and its answer is recorded here. Every entry is merged as via:"model" whatever it claims, and a model edge is a proposal: only an execution receipt in executed-edges.jsonl may carry a task. Shape: {capability?, from, to, type: "parameter"|"semantic", confidence: 0..1, rationale}.
